# Next.js judge-level rules (plugin). Pairs with shapes/nextjs.md. Composed on top
# of the react + web-app fragments (nextjs builds on react builds on web-app), so
# the server-boundary/authorization/URL-state rules come from
# shapes/web-app.llmlint.yml and the React architecture/hooks/XSS rules from
# shapes/react.llmlint.yml; this adds only the Next.js-specific
# server-action/route-handler validation judgment. The one-time production-build
# check is buildout-only (buildout/shapes/nextjs...).
version: 1

rules:
  - name: server_input_validated_with_schema
    description: |
      true when every Route Handler and Server Action in the target files validates
      its input (request body, form data, search params) with a runtime schema (e.g.
      Zod) before using it. false when a handler or action trusts `unknown`/`any`
      input from the request directly, so malformed or hostile input reaches the
      server logic unchecked.
    files:
      include:
        - "**/route.ts"
        - "**/route.tsx"
        - "**/actions.ts"
        - "**/actions.tsx"
        - "**/*.action.ts"
    relevance: the target files define a Next.js Route Handler or Server Action
